Question: 在下列实例中，分别属于相对性状和性状分离的是____
①羊的长角与短腿
②水稻的非糯性和糯性
③兔的粗毛和狗的细毛
④高茎豌豆与矮茎豌豆杂交,后代全为高茎豌豆
⑤开红花的牡丹与开白花的牡丹杂交,后代全开粉红花
⑥白毛兔与白毛兔杂交后代中出现了灰毛兔
Options A. ②⑥ B. ②④ C. ①⑤ D. ③⑤

Need identify which instance is relative trait (相对性状) and which is trait segregation (性状分离). "分别属于相对性状和性状分离的是" means among the examples, one belongs to relative trait, one belongs to trait separation? Probably select pair: first is 相对性状, second is 性状分离. Need find relative trait: same species, same trait, different表现形式. ②水稻的非糯性和糯性: same species rice, same trait (starch type) different forms -> relative trait. ③兔的粗毛和狗的细毛: different species -> not. ①羊的长角与短腿: same species?羊 but different traits (horn length vs leg length) -> not relative trait. So relative trait is ②.
Trait segregation: phenomenon in self-cross/hybridization where offspring of same phenotype parents show both dominant and recessive traits? Generally 性状分离: in offspring of hybrids, appearance of both dominant and recessive traits. More broadly: parents same trait, offspring appear different trait (segregation of traits). ⑥白毛兔与白毛兔杂交后代中出现了灰毛兔: same phenotype parents, offspring has different phenotype -> trait segregation? Yes if white is dominant, gray recessive? Or white x white produce gray indicates segregation. ④ high x dwarf -> all high is dominance, not separation. ⑤ red x white -> all pink is incomplete dominance/blending, not segregation. So ②⑥, option A.

Need final line format. Provide brief explanation likely. Ensure final: 答案：A.
content:
相对性状是指同种生物同一性状的不同表现类型，②水稻的非糯性和糯性属于相对性状。  
性状分离是指杂种后代中同时出现显性性状和隐性性状的现象，⑥白毛兔与白毛兔杂交后代中出现了灰毛兔，属于性状分离。
